def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(nil)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil:)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil?
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !false && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && nil
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && true
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      result

      token
    end
  else

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token && quote_wrapped?(token)

    end

  end

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token

  end
end

    end
  else

  end
end

    end
  else

  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if false
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    return stripped
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    if stripped.empty?
      nil
    else

    end
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)

        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

    begin

      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if true
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      result

      token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return false ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if nil
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if false
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end

  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(nil)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end
  else
    token
  end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = context
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      if allow_nil

      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if false
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if true
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      nil
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if nil
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if self.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      nil
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      "Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}"
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug(nil)
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{self.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped

    begin

      if allow_nil

      end

      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{nil}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    nil
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
